---
mode: agent
description: Investigate and fix Storybook issues in this repository
---

Investigate the Storybook problem in this project and fix the underlying issue.

Please:
- reproduce the problem first if possible
- inspect the Storybook configuration and relevant component stories
- identify the root cause before making changes
- make the smallest change that resolves the issue
- verify the fix with the relevant command

Focus on:
- missing exports
- story syntax issues
- styling or rendering regressions
- component API mismatches

When you finish, provide:
- the root cause
- the change made
- the verification evidence
